question: Should Neuralwatt display both prepaid USD credits and active subscription kWh allowance, or intentionally define CodexBar's provider as prepaid-balance-only?
rationale: Neuralwatt exposes two independently usable quota pools, while this branch displays only prepaid credits and can therefore report apparent exhaustion for an account that still has subscription capacity.

options.title: Display both quota pools
options.body: Add a separate subscription kWh window while retaining prepaid USD credits so the menu accurately represents overall account availability.

options.title: Accept balance-only semantics
options.body: Merge only after explicitly approving that narrower contract and revising UI wording and documentation so prepaid exhaustion is not presented as total account exhaustion.

recommendation.title: Display both quota pools
recommendation.body: Add a separate subscription kWh window while retaining prepaid USD credits so the menu accurately represents overall account availability.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the Neuralwatt hardening commits and recorded the unresolved product choice in the related implementation audit.
